acceptanceCriteria: A policy file declares glob-scoped rules requiring a citation relation or evidence path, each with mode warn or error.
cem status reports each violated rule per hunk and fails only on error-mode rules, with fixtures for both modes.
The policy is project-owned and read from the base tree, never from the change under review.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner-requested gap analysis of Corvint against competing context tools, current standards and a trial on a local clone of MeVille (TypeScript, about 4,600 tracked files). CEM policy today is global (`--max-unknown`, `--max-mechanical`). Review tools enforce invariants as separate scoped checks: Amp `.agents/checks/`, CodeRabbit pre-merge checks in warning or error mode, Cursor BUGBOT.md. A repository-owned policy file saying that hunks under a glob must cite a named authority (for example, internal/cem/** cites the CEM spec) turns prose rules into verified obligations, and warning mode allows gradual rollout.
title: cem: path-scoped check policies with warning and error modes
